verses_he.label: القرار
lines: הֶבֶל וְכָלֶה הוּא, וּרְעוּת רוּחַ הוּא
הֵן אָנֹכִי שִׁחְרַרְתִּי אוֹתְךָ, בָּחַרְתִּי בְךָ

review: The hymn is the desire for Christ above the world: 1:1–4 is Ps 73:25–26 with Ps 16:11, the chorus is Ps 73:2 with Eccl 1:14 (הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רוּחַ) and 1 Cor 1:5, 2:1–4 is Rom 8:35–39 with Ps 23:1, and 3:1–4 is 1 John 2:15 with John 15:16.
The chorus is placed after stanza 1 as [القرار]; the payload keeps it there, so the poem moves desire–disillusion–assurance–correction.

1:4 and 3:4 keep the first person's possessive forms on both sides of the exchange, because the Arabic pairs my joy / my peace with 'Precious to Me are you' in 3:4, and the Hebrew must sound the same voice speaking both parts.
